findings.problem: Fault injection starts before its restoration try/finally. A stop/kill that mutates one service then raises/ times out bypasses restoration. verify also runs e2e as a 900s subprocess whose forced timeout termination bypasses child finally blocks.
findings.consequence: A failed evidence command can leave the local worker/recovery/API stopped, contaminating later acceptance runs.
findings.required_change: Enter restoration guard before every stop/kill; preserve original failure and report restoration outcome. Ensure the verify timeout can restore the run-owned affected services (or gracefully cancel and then restore from its supervisor). Add bounded controlled regressions for injection failure after mutation and outer timeout restoration.
findings.fix_status: not yet verified; owned by other agent

findings.problem: browser_workflow toggles to register and never exercises login in the real browser. auth/login is called only by a separate httpx polling client. Existing frontend login test uses mocked fetch/jsdom.
findings.consequence: The explicit V1 real-browser login criterion has no implemented real-browser test; registration success can hide a broken login UI.
findings.required_change: After registration, log out/clear the browser session, submit existing credentials through the login UI, await the actual successful login response and app state, then continue the same workflow.
findings.fix_status: not yet verified; owned by other agent

findings.problem: CT-20 lacks accepted source-invalid geometry -> visible failed Attempt evidence; CT-21 lacks retained edit-key replay after derived Asset deletion; CT-23 does not validate prepared examples.json. Nearby pure validators/upload replay/schema-reference tests cover different assertions.
findings.consequence: All 25 cases have mappings, but required variants in CT-20/21/23 can regress while every current mapped test passes.
findings.required_change: Add three small focused checks: a schema-valid out-of-source crop or over-duration clip through current Processing execution/public failed projection with no output; deleting a derived Asset then replaying its retained edit key must 410 without recreation; validate every prepared example against the correct schema and make a malformed example fail. These need no new product/security feature.
findings.fix_status: code implemented; offline schema/lint/collection passed; live verification pending

findings.problem: browser_workflow accepts any advancing video but labels it played HLS. It does not require hls_url, observe successful HLS playlist/segment use or assert selected HLS playback rather than MP4 fallback. Public HLS traversal only checks nonempty segment bytes. Diagnostic parent probe played both formats but has no existing committed function.
findings.consequence: Broken HLS decoding can pass the final harness through MP4 fallback while report claims HLS playback.
findings.required_change: Make the browser gate prove the selected HLS playback path and advancing decoded video, and exercise/retain an explicit MP4 path too (a small existing-browser probe is sufficient). Alternatively narrow the workflow label and add the format-specific checks to the callable final acceptance harness. Keep the valid scoped browser choice.
findings.fix_status: not yet verified; owned by other agent
